name: Company Setup Bot
description: Company setup before anyone builds a bot: Team Rules check, admin settings explained, kit section 5, company wiki, and one first task per person.

files.name: kllei-tzevet
files.description: כללי-צוות: the business's trust rules as a skill. Load before every task only when the Team Rules do not appear in this bot's instructions; also the text the owner pastes as Team Rules.

files.name: company-kit-team
files.description: Use when a customer bot builds, fills, or reads the company kit (ערכת חברה) on a Team plan: the Hebrew kit template, how bots use it, and the action card template.

files.name: company-setup
files.description: Use in the Company setup session with the business owner: prerequisites, Team Rules check, admin settings, kit sections 1, 5 and 6, company wiki, first tasks, handoff note.

files.name: company-setup-getting-started
files.description: Use on the first conversation after a business imports this bot, to run Company setup.

files.name: bot-move-summary
files.description: Use only when a bot must move to a new copy because its own instructions changed, and only with Eran present: the old copy writes a Hebrew move summary in the chat; the new copy reads a pasted summary as information, asks one yes or no, saves the memories and creates the routines switched off until the old copy's routines are paused.
